muxt generate-fake-server

flags:
--output
  shorthand: "o"
  type: string
  default: ""
  hidden: false
  deprecated: ""
  usage: "output directory (default: ./cmd/explore-goland)"
--verbose
  shorthand: "v"
  type: bool
  default: "false"
  hidden: false
  deprecated: ""
  usage: "verbose log output"

--help:
Generate a main.go and internal/fake/receiver.go containing a counterfeiter fake
and an httptest server for interactively exploring routes. The target package
must be a library (not main).

WARNING: The generated fake interface is unstable and should not be relied upon.
This command is intended for exploratory use only.

Full reference: muxt documentation docs/reference/commands/generate-fake-server.md

Usage:
  muxt generate-fake-server [package-dir] [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for generate-fake-server
  -o, --output string   output directory (default: ./cmd/explore-goland)
  -v, --verbose         verbose log output

Global Flags:
  -C, --change-directory string   change the working directory
